BOTTOM LINE: I executed the full pipeline, but the final count CANNOT be produced in this execution environment because the KEGG 'paer' database needed for the over-representation step is unobtainable here. Per your instruction I did NOT guess/invent the count.

WHAT I EXECUTED (analysis.py, run to completion of every step it can):
• Steps A–B (offline, succeeded): loaded both DESeq2 'DESeqResult' tables (5828 genes each) and selected significantly DOWNREGULATED genes (log2FoldChange <= -1.5 AND padj <= 0.05):
    – GluFe-vs-GluFePlus : 91 genes  (out/down_GluFe-vs-GluFePlus.csv)
    – Succ-vs-GluFePlus  : 289 genes (out/down_Succ-vs-GluFePlus.csv)
• Step C (KEGG fetch): ATTEMPTED and FAILED — see precise diagnosis below.
• Steps D–F (mapping + hypergeometric enrichment + BH + intersection): NOT executed (blocked by C). The logic is fully implemented in analysis.py and will run as-is once KEGG is reachable.

PRECISE DIAGNOSIS OF WHAT IS MISSING (verified, not assumed):
• NO NETWORK: every egress attempt fails. DNS: "Temporary failure in name resolution" for www.kegg.jp/rest.kegg.jp/pypi.org/github.com. Raw TCP (bypassing DNS): Errno 101 "Network is unreachable" to 1.1.1.1:443, 8.8.8.8:53, 93.184.216.34:80, and 151.106.54.162:443 (rest.kegg.jp IP with SNI). No proxy vars. => the sandbox has no network interface at all, so the "latest KEGG db" cannot be fetched.
• NO R interpreter: `R`/`Rscript` not found anywhere; apt is broken (no /etc/apt, no dpkg lock) so R can't be installed.
• NO KEGGREST: it is an R package and R is absent.
• NO local KEGG cache: a whole-filesystem search found no KEGG/brite/pathway/map0 files and no file containing 'PA0001'/'map00010'/'paer'.
• NO offline package source: `pip install` and `apt-get` both fail; no conda. Installed Python pkgs are only numpy/scipy/pandas/statsmodels (+deps) — no KEGG data.

APPLIED CHOICES (as you specified, and hard-coded in the scripts):
(1) gene selection = log2FoldChange <= -1.5 AND padj <= 0.05 (downregulated) — DONE (91 / 289).
(2) organism 'paer'; over-representation = hypergeometric (clusterProfiler::enrichKEGG/enrichPathway equivalent); LATEST fetchable KEGG release pinned+reported (script reads /info/kegg and prints it).
(3) universe = full KEGG 'paer' gene list (standard enrichKEGG universe).
(4) enrichment significance = BH-adjusted q-value <= 0.05.
(5) 'common' = exact KEGG pathway-ID (map number) intersection of the two comparisons' significantly-enriched sets.

READY-TO-RUN ARTIFACTS:
• analysis.py (EXECUTED here; needs only network — no R required; fetches KEGG via rest.kegg.jp, maps PA14_XXXXX locus tags to 'paer' genes with exact-tag then 5-digit fallback, reports mappable vs unmappable, runs the hypergeometric + BH, intersects, prints the count).
• analysis.R (supplementary, for the R provisioned runner using KEGGREST; same logic; NOT executed here because R is absent).

TO GET THE COUNT: run `python3 analysis.py` (or `Rscript analysis.R`) in any environment with network access to https://rest.kegg.jp, or provide the KEGG 'paer' gene list + gene→pathway links as local files. The script also reports how many of the 91/289 PA14 locus tags are unmappable to 'paer' and the effect. I will not state a number I did not compute.
